title: CSKA clinch BBL Division A title
description: CSKA Sofia - Shumen II 79:62 CSKA clinched BBL Division A title in Bulgaria. They edged Shumen II 79:62. Trailing 21-22 at the end of the first period, CSKA Sofia posted a 14-8 run in the second frame. Moreover, they took control in the second half and nailed two more victories. Dimitar Genov (194-SG-2002) stepped up with 23 points and Asen Popov (210-C-1997, agency: Interperformances) produced 12. Viktor Gergov (200-F/G-2003) and Vladimir Nankinski (197-SF-2004) ended up with 10 points each in a win. Viktor Serafimov (190-G/F-2000) poured in 24 points in the losing effort.
